image.description: A `Tensor` of type `uint8`. 3-D with shape `[height, width, channels]`.

format.description: An optional `string` from: `"", "grayscale", "rgb"`. Defaults to `""`. Per pixel image format.

quality.description: An optional `int`. Defaults to `95`. Quality of the compression from 0 to 100 (higher is better and slower).

progressive.description: An optional `bool`. Defaults to `False`. If True, create a JPEG that loads progressively (coarse to fine).

optimize_size.description: An optional `bool`. Defaults to `False`. If True, spend CPU/RAM to reduce size with no quality change.

density_unit.description: An optional `string` from: `"in", "cm"`. Defaults to `"in"`. Unit used to specify `x_density` and `y_density`: pixels per inch (`'in'`) or centimeter (`'cm'`).

x_density.description: An optional `int`. Defaults to `300`. Horizontal pixels per density unit.

y_density.description: An optional `int`. Defaults to `300`. Vertical pixels per density unit.

xmp_metadata.description: An optional `string`. Defaults to `""`. If not empty, embed this XMP metadata in the image header.
